semantics.reset: active high synchronous; reset sampled high at rising edge sets q to 0 with priority over counting
semantics.transition: On each rising edge with reset low, q becomes (previous q + 1) modulo 16
semantics.between_edges: q holds its value; changing reset alone does not change q
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; use synchronous reset to establish known state
semantics.period: 16 rising edges with reset low return to the same known count

verification.oracle: independent integer expected state updated at rising edges: reset gives 0, otherwise (expected + 1) % 16
directed_checks: all 16 counter states and repeated wraparound
reset asserted and deasserted between edges preserves q
reset held over multiple rising edges
verification.observation: compare after nonblocking assignments settle; do not assume pre-reset q
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012 with explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Power-up q before a synchronous reset is unspecified; no initialization is added.
